usageNotes: Use this to permanently remove an LDAP/AD realm from Proxmox Datacenter Manager. The caller must hold the Realm.Allocate privilege on the access/domains path. Pass the optional digest (obtained from a prior get of the realm config) to guard against concurrent modifications — the delete will be rejected if the config has changed since the digest was captured.

examples.summary: Delete an AD realm named 'corp-ad', with optimistic-lock digest to prevent race conditions

destructiveReason: Permanently removes the LDAP/AD realm configuration; any users or tokens associated with this realm will lose authentication access and cannot be recovered without reconfiguring the realm.
tips: Fetch the current realm config first (e.g. GET /config/access/ad/{realm}) to obtain the SHA256 digest before deleting — this prevents accidental deletion if the config was modified concurrently.
Ensure no active users depend on this realm before deletion; PDM does not cascade-delete user accounts tied to the realm.
Returns null on success — a 2xx with no body is the expected response.
